item.title: El Presidente: Senior Counsel Charles Kanjama Elected 52nd LSK President
item.description: Senior Counsel Charles Kanjama has been elected President of the Law Society of Kenya (LSK), becoming the 52nd person to hold the office following a closely watched election held on February 19, 2026, with results announced the following day. For many in the legal fraternity, the outcome was more than a routine leadership transition — it was the ascent of one of Kenya’s sharpest legal minds to a seat the country cannot afford to leave in ordinary hands.
